title: O God, Our Help in Ages Past
description: O God, Our Help in Ages Past in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, six verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts paraphrased Psalm 90 in The Psalms of David Imitated (1719), beginning 'Our God, our help'; John Wesley changed the first word to 'O' in 1738. The tune ST ANNE, by William Croft, organist at St Anne's Church, Soho, was first printed in 1708.
underlay: O God, our help in a-ges past, Our hope for years to come, Our shel-ter from the storm-y blast, And our e-ter-nal home.

lines: O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Our shelter from the stormy blast,
Under the shadow of Thy throne
Before the hills in order stood,
A thousand ages in Thy sight
Short as the watch that ends the night
They fly forgotten, as a dream
O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Be Thou our guard while troubles last,
